_about: Per-trip content for the promo packs: map stops and legs, the highlights on the title cards, and the video beats. Facts (nights, travelers, what's included) come from the kit's trips.json; this file only shapes how they are shown. Coordinates are [lon, lat]. When the research session adds coordinates to trips.json they take precedence (matched by stop name). Copy rules: no auction language, no prices (the price slot follows trips.json `showPrices`), never the provider's name, nothing about buying after the Gala.

music._about: Each trip sets its own `music` (a CC BY track on Wikimedia Commons). Jeff should audition each before it plays at the Gala; every cut is also written silent.

score._about: Each trip's `score` names Jeff's Envato track (paths under Supp video/_music/<trip>/). `use` picks 'track' or 'alternate' (one setting to swap). The track's own edits in the same folder (30/60 s edits, shorts) are used for cuts they fit; otherwise the full track is cut at phrase lines to its real ending. Videos are cut to the music; see score.mjs.
